"Platform" means the QuotesDone website, applications and services. "Customer", "you" means the business or individual requesting quotations. "Reveal" means unlocking the identity and contact details of a chosen Supplier. "Reveal Fee" has the meaning in clause 4.

2. The service and how anonymous quoting works

QuotesDone lets you describe a job (by text, voice, photo or drawing). Our system structures your request and matches it to vetted Suppliers, who submit competing quotations on an anonymised basis - you can compare prices and scope without any party's identity being disclosed.

QuotesDone is a marketplace and facilitator only. It is not a contractor, supplier, agent or party to any contract for the works. Quotes are prepared by independent Suppliers who are solely responsible for their pricing, scope and performance.

Comparing quotes is free. A Reveal Fee becomes payable only when you choose to reveal a Supplier you wish to engage.

The Reveal Fee is three percent (3%) of the value of the selected quotation. There is NO maximum cap on the Reveal Fee. The exact amount is shown to you clearly before you confirm payment.

The Reveal Fee is paid through the Platform (card or Apple Pay) and is charged once per reveal. Revealing a Supplier does not create any contract between you and QuotesDone for the underlying works; it unlocks the Supplier's identity so you may contract with them directly.

All Reveal Fees are stated exclusive of VAT. Where QuotesDone is registered for VAT, VAT at the prevailing rate (currently 5%) is added and shown on a valid tax invoice issued under Federal Decree-Law No. 8 of 2017. No escrow; QuotesDone does not hold your money. The only payment QuotesDone collects is its own Reveal Fee, charged through Stripe at the moment of Reveal. شروط الخدمة

للعملاء الذين يستخدمون QuotesDone لطلب العروض وكشف الموردين.

تحكم هذه الشروط والأحكام ("الشروط") استخدامك لمنصة QuotesDone كعميل. QuotesDone هي المنصة الإلكترونية التي تديرها QuotesDone Technologies، وهي مؤسسة فردية مرخصة من قبل دائرة الاقتصاد والسياحة في دبي (رخصة التاجر الإلكتروني (المهني) رقم 1633275؛ السجل التجاري رقم 2883503)، دبي، الإمارات العربية المتحدة ("QuotesDone"، "نحن"، "لنا"). QuotesDone هي سوق إلكتروني للتوريد بين الشركات تعمل في دبي، الإمارات العربية المتحدة. بإنشاء حساب، أو تقديم طلب عروض أسعار، أو دفع رسوم الكشف، فإنك تقبل هذه الشروط. القبول بالوسائل الإلكترونية (بما في ذلك القبول بالنقر) صالح وملزم بموجب المرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم 46 لسنة 2021 بشأن المعاملات الإلكترونية وخدمات الثقة.

1. التعريفات

"المنصة" تعني موقع QuotesDone، التطبيقات والخدمات. "العميل"، "أنت" تعني العمل أو الفرد الذي يطلب العروض. "المورد" يعني مقدم خدمة من طرف ثالث تم التحقق منه يقدم العروض. "الاستفسار" يعني طلب عروض الأسعار الذي تقدمه. "العرض" يعني عرض أسعار مجهول الهوية من المورد. "الكشف" يعني فتح هوية وتفاصيل الاتصال بمورد مختار. "رسوم الكشف" لها المعنى في البند 4.

2. الخدمة وكيفية عمل العروض المجهولة الهوية

تتيح لك QuotesDone وصف العمل (بالنص، الصوت، الصورة أو الرسم). يقوم نظامنا بتنظيم طلبك ومطابقته مع الموردين الذين تم التحقق منهم، والذين يقدمون عروض أسعار متنافسة على أساس مجهول الهوية - يمكنك مقارنة الأسعار والنطاق دون الكشف عن هوية أي طرف.

QuotesDone هي سوق وميسر فقط. ليست مقاولًا، موردًا، وكيلًا أو طرفًا في أي عقد للأعمال. يتم إعداد العروض من قبل الموردين المستقلين الذين يتحملون وحدهم مسؤولية تسعيرهم، نطاقهم وأدائهم.

3. الحساب والأهلية

يجب عليك تقديم تفاصيل تسجيل دقيقة والحفاظ على أمان حسابك. أنت مسؤول عن النشاط تحت حسابك. يجب أن تكون مخولًا لشراء الخدمات التي تطلبها.

4. رسوم الكشف (3%، بدون حد أقصى) وضريبة القيمة المضافة

مقارنة العروض مجانية. تصبح رسوم الكشف مستحقة الدفع فقط عندما تختار الكشف عن مورد ترغب في التعامل معه.

رسوم الكشف هي ثلاثة بالمائة (3%) من قيمة العرض المختار. لا يوجد حد أقصى لرسوم الكشف. يتم عرض المبلغ الدقيق لك بوضوح قبل تأكيد الدفع.

يتم دفع رسوم الكشف عبر المنصة (بطاقة أو Apple Pay) ويتم تحصيلها مرة واحدة لكل كشف. الكشف عن المورد لا ينشئ أي عقد بينك وبين QuotesDone للأعمال الأساسية؛ إنه يفتح هوية المورد حتى تتمكن من التعاقد معهم مباشرة.

جميع رسوم الكشف مذكورة بدون ضريبة القيمة المضافة. حيثما تكون QuotesDone مسجلة لضريبة القيمة المضافة، تضاف ضريبة القيمة المضافة بالسعر السائد (حاليًا 5%) وتظهر على فاتورة ضريبية صالحة صادرة بموجب المرسوم بقانون اتحادي رقم 8 لسنة 2017. قبل تأكيد الدفع يتم عرض رسوم الكشف الدقيقة لك بالدرهم الإماراتي كمبلغ إجمالي واحد، شاملًا أي ضريبة قيمة مضافة قابلة للتطبيق، دون أي رسوم مخفية أو إضافية للكشف.

5. الاسترداد، الأداء الفوري والشكاوى حول الموردين غير المستجيبين

أنت تطلب صراحة أن تقوم QuotesDone بتنفيذ الكشف فور الدفع، وتقر بأن الخدمة — الكشف عن هوية وتفاصيل الاتصال بالمورد — يتم تنفيذها وتسليمها بالكامل إلكترونيًا في لحظة الكشف. بمجرد تسليم الكشف، يتم استنفاد أي حق في الإلغاء قبل التسليم وتكون رسوم الكشف مستحقة. رسوم الكشف غير قابلة للاسترداد تلقائيًا، ولا يوجد استرداد ذاتي الخدمة.

إذا لم يستجب المورد لك بعد الكشف، فلا تحتاج إلى فعل أي شيء لبدء احتساب المدة: تتابع QuotesDone كل عملية كشف من لحظة دفعك. إذا لم يستجب المورد خلال ثلاثة (3) أيام عمل من دفعك، تتابع QuotesDone المورد نيابةً عنك مع إرسال نسخة إليك. وإذا لم تصل أي استجابة بحلول يوم العمل الخامس (5)، تُحال الحالة إلى الرئيس التنفيذي لـ QuotesDone لإجراء اتصال أخير. ويمكنك أيضًا تقديم شكوى عبر المنصة في أي وقت؛ كما أن الاتصال بالمورد كتابيًا (على سبيل المثال عبر البريد الإلكتروني) مع نسخ supplier@quotesdone.com يُثبت محاولتك الخاصة للوصول إلى المورد.

إذا لم يستجب المورد لك ولـ QuotesDone خلال خمسة (5) أيام عمل من دفعك ولم يستجب للاتصال الأخير من الرئيس التنفيذي، تُردّ رسوم الكشف. والمبلغ المردود هو كامل رسوم الكشف التي دفعتها (3% من قيمة العرض)؛ ولا تخصم QuotesDone أي شيء منه. ويقرر الرئيس التنفيذي لـ QuotesDone كل عملية استرداد، ويُسجَّل القرار برقم مرجع حالة الاسترداد الخاصة بك الذي نذكره لك عند تأكيد النتيجة؛ فلا يوجد استرداد تلقائي ولا استرداد ذاتي الخدمة. وبعد إصدار الاسترداد، تستغرق البنوك ومصدرو البطاقات عادةً من سبعة (7) إلى أربعة عشر (14) يوم عمل لإظهاره في كشف حسابك. أيام العمل هي من الاثنين إلى الجمعة، باستثناء العطلات الرسمية في الإمارات العربية المتحدة.

يعتبر المورد قد "استجاب" إذا رد بأي وسيلة معقولة، بما في ذلك سلسلة الرسائل على المنصة، الهاتف، البريد الإلكتروني أو واتساب. لا يحق لك استرداد، إعادة مطابقة أو رصيد حيث: استجاب المورد؛ لقد قمت بالفعل بالتعامل، التعاقد مع، أو الاتصال بالمورد خارج المنصة بخلاف البريد الإلكتروني للشكوى الموضح أعلاه؛ تم الكشف عن نفس المورد لك سابقًا؛ أنت غير راضٍ عن سعر المورد، عرضه أو شروطه؛ أو لقد غيرت رأيك ببساطة. قد ترفض QuotesDone أو تحد من الطلبات المتكررة التي تشير إلى إساءة استخدام هذه السياسة.

عدم الكشف هو جوهر الخدمة. توافق على عدم السعي، القبول أو استخدام أي وسيلة لتحديد أو الاتصال بمورد خارج المنصة قبل الكشف المدفوع، وعدم استخدام المنصة للحصول على هويات الموردين ثم التعامل خارج المنصة لتجنب رسوم الكشف.

يتم تقديم العروض وأي مرفقات لتقييمك فقط ويجب عدم مشاركتها بطريقة تتحايل على المنصة.

توافق على تقديم معلومات دقيقة، استخدام المنصة بشكل قانوني، عدم تقديم استفسارات احتيالية أو مسيئة، وعدم إساءة استخدام، كشط، أو التدخل في المنصة أو بيانات المستخدمين الآخرين.

Privacy Policy

QuotesDone Technologies · Version 1.3 · Last updated 14 September 2026
The English version of this document is the governing version.

Privacy Policy

How QuotesDone Technologies collects, uses, shares and protects personal data on the QuotesDone anonymous quotation marketplace, and your rights under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 (the Personal Data Protection Law).

1. Who We Are (Data Controller)

This Privacy Policy explains how we handle your personal data when you use QuotesDone, an online B2B anonymous quotation marketplace.

The data controller is:

  • QuotesDone Technologies, a Dubai Sole Establishment
  • Dubai DET E-Trader (Professional) Licence No. 1633275
  • Commercial Register No. 2883503
  • Owner: Ahmad Mhd Nabil Alzain
  • Address: Dubai, United Arab Emirates
  • Email: management@quotesdone.com; Phone: +971 50 931 9355 (the number on our licence record is +971 56 791 8605)

We process personal data in accordance with the UAE Personal Data Protection Law, Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 (PDPL), and its implementing regime overseen by the UAE Data Office, which from June 2026 operates within the new UAE Federal Authority for Artificial Intelligence and Data. This policy applies to customers, suppliers and visitors. Where you act on behalf of a business, references to your personal data mean the personal data of the individuals concerned.

2. Personal Data We Collect

Depending on how you use the platform, we collect:

  • Customer identity and contact data: your name, email address and mobile number, with the mobile number verified by one-time password (OTP).
  • Request content: the job or request you submit as text, voice recordings, photographs or drawings, including any personal data you choose to include.
  • Supplier data: business details and Know Your Customer (KYC) documents provided for vetting and onboarding.
  • Payment data: a payment reference returned by our payment processor, Stripe. We do not store full card numbers; card and Apple Pay details are handled by Stripe, which is certified to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard (PCI DSS).
  • Usage and technical data: logs, device and connection information, and records of platform activity.

We do not intentionally collect special categories of data. Please avoid including sensitive details in request content unless necessary.

3. Purposes and Lawful Bases

We process personal data for clear purposes, each supported by a lawful basis under the PDPL:

  • To create and manage your account, verify your mobile by OTP, and provide the marketplace, including matching requests to suppliers and enabling paid reveals (performance of a contract).
  • To calculate and collect the customer Reveal Fee of 3% of the quoted value at the point you choose to reveal a supplier, and to keep accounting records (performance of a contract and legal obligation). Suppliers pay no commission or success fee on jobs they win.
  • To vet suppliers and verify KYC documents, prevent fraud and misuse, secure the platform and improve our services (legitimate interests).
  • To share a chosen supplier's contact details on a paid reveal, and for optional marketing (your consent, which you may withdraw at any time).

Where we rely on legitimate interests, we balance these against your rights and interests.

4. AI and Automated Processing

QuotesDone uses automated tools, including artificial intelligence, to operate the marketplace. These tools:

  • Structure and standardise the requests you submit (including converting voice, photos and drawings into a structured brief).
  • Match each request to vetted suppliers likely to be able to quote.
  • Summarise requests and quotes to make them easier to compare.

This automated processing supports our service but does not produce binding legal effects on you without human involvement, and you remain free to accept, reject or ignore any quote. You may contact us to ask questions about, or object to, automated processing as described in the Your Rights section. Where automated processing could significantly affect individuals, we assess its impact before deploying it.

5. How We Share Data

Anonymity is central to QuotesDone. We share personal data only as follows:

  • Request content is shared with matched suppliers WITHOUT revealing your identity, so suppliers can prepare anonymised quotes.
  • Your contact details are disclosed to a single supplier only after you pay the Reveal Fee and consent to the reveal for that chosen supplier; suppliers receive customer contact data only for jobs revealed to them.
  • Our payment processor, Stripe, receives the data needed to take payment (card or Apple Pay) and returns a payment reference.
  • Service providers (such as hosting, communications and analytics) process data on our behalf under written instructions.

We may also disclose data where required by UAE law, a court of competent authority, or to protect our legal rights. We do not sell personal data.

6. Cross-Border Transfers

Some of our service providers may process personal data outside the United Arab Emirates. Where this happens, we apply the safeguards required by Articles 22 and 23 of the PDPL.

  • We transfer data to countries the UAE Data Office recognises as providing an adequate level of protection; or
  • Where adequacy is not established, we rely on appropriate safeguards such as contractual clauses obliging the recipient to protect the data to UAE standards, or on your explicit consent, in each case in a manner that does not conflict with the public and security interests of the State.

You may contact us for more information about the specific safeguards applied to a transfer.

7. Data Retention

We keep personal data only for as long as necessary for the purposes described above and to meet legal obligations.

  • Account data is kept while your account is active and for a reasonable period afterwards.
  • Request content is retained to operate and improve matching, then deleted or anonymised when no longer needed.
  • Transaction and financial records, including Reveal Fee and registration-fee records, are retained for the periods required by UAE accounting and tax law.
  • Supplier KYC documents are retained for the duration of the relationship and any legally required period thereafter.
  • Logs are kept for limited periods for security and audit purposes.

When a retention period ends, we securely delete or irreversibly anonymise the data. Our internal Data Protection and Retention Policy sets out the detailed schedule.

8. Your Rights Under the PDPL

Subject to the conditions and exceptions in the PDPL, you have the right to:

  • Access your personal data and obtain information about how it is processed.
  • Request correction of inaccurate or incomplete data.
  • Request deletion of your data where the legal grounds apply.
  • Object to, or request restriction of, certain processing, including processing based on legitimate interests and certain automated processing.
  • Request that your personal data be provided to you, or transferred to another controller, in a structured, commonly used, machine-readable format (data portability), where technically feasible.
  • Request that your data be transferred to you or another controller in a structured format, where applicable.
  • Withdraw consent at any time, without affecting processing carried out before withdrawal.

To exercise any right, contact us at management@quotesdone.com. We will respond within the timeframes required by the PDPL. If you are not satisfied, you may lodge a complaint with the UAE Data Office.

9. Electronic Marketing and Communications

We send transactional messages you need to use the service — for example mobile one-time passwords (OTP), request and quote notifications, and account or payment confirmations — on the basis of our contract with you; these are not marketing.

We send marketing or promotional messages by email, SMS or other electronic means only where you have given consent, and you can withdraw consent or unsubscribe at any time using the link or instructions in the message, or by emailing management@quotesdone.com. We handle electronic communications in line with the UAE telecommunications and electronic-marketing rules overseen by the Telecommunications and Digital Government Regulatory Authority (TDRA) and the Electronic Transactions and Trust Services Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021). We do not sell your contact details for third-party marketing.

10. Security

We apply appropriate technical and organisational measures to protect personal data against unauthorised access, loss, alteration or disclosure, consistent with the PDPL and the Electronic Transactions and Trust Services Law, Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021.

  • Access to personal data is restricted to authorised personnel on a need-to-know basis.
  • We use encryption in transit, OTP verification for customer mobile numbers, and segregation of anonymised request content from identity data.
  • Payment card data is handled by Stripe, our PCI DSS–certified payment processor, and is not stored by us.

No system can be guaranteed to be completely secure. If a personal data breach occurs that meets the legal threshold, we will notify the UAE Data Office and affected individuals as required by the PDPL.

11. Children, Changes and Contact

QuotesDone is a business-to-business platform intended for users aged 18 and over. It is not directed at minors, and we do not knowingly collect personal data from children. If you believe a minor has provided us data, please contact us so we can delete it.

We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time to reflect changes in our services or the law. The current version is always available on our platform, and material changes will be notified where appropriate.

For any privacy question, to exercise your rights, or to reach our data protection contact, please use:

  • Email: management@quotesdone.com
  • Phone: +971 50 931 9355 (licence record: +971 56 791 8605)
  • Post: QuotesDone Technologies, Dubai, United Arab Emirates (our DET E-Trader portal licence is for an online business with no shop front, so there is no street address)

This policy is governed by the laws of the UAE, and disputes are subject to the courts of Dubai.

Operator: QuotesDone Technologies, Dubai DET E-Trader (Professional) Licence No. 1633275, Commercial Register No. 2883503, Dubai, UAE. Governing law: the laws of the United Arab Emirates, including the Commercial Transactions Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 50 of 2022), the Electronic Transactions and Trust Services Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021), the Consumer Protection Law (Federal Law No. 15 of 2020) and Cabinet Resolution No. 66 of 2023, the Personal Data Protection Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021), and the Civil Transactions Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025, in force from 1 June 2026). 2. البيانات الشخصية التي نجمعها

اعتمادًا على كيفية استخدامك للمنصة، نقوم بجمع:

  • محتوى الطلب: المشروع أو الطلب الذي تقدمه كنص، تسجيلات صوتية، صور أو رسومات، بما في ذلك أي بيانات شخصية تختار تضمينها.
  • بيانات المورد: تفاصيل الأعمال ومستندات اعرف عميلك (KYC) المقدمة للتحقق والاعتماد.
  • بيانات الدفع: مرجع الدفع الذي يعيده معالج الدفع لدينا، Stripe. لا نخزّن أرقام البطاقات الكاملة؛ وتتولى Stripe، المعتمدة وفق معيار أمان بيانات صناعة بطاقات الدفع (PCI DSS)، التعامل مع تفاصيل البطاقة وApple Pay.
  • بيانات الاستخدام والتقنية: السجلات، معلومات الجهاز والاتصال، وسجلات نشاط المنصة.

نحن لا نجمع عمدًا فئات خاصة من البيانات. يرجى تجنب تضمين تفاصيل حساسة في محتوى الطلب إلا إذا كان ذلك ضروريًا.

3. الأغراض والأسس القانونية

نقوم بمعالجة البيانات الشخصية لأغراض واضحة، كل منها مدعوم بأساس قانوني بموجب PDPL:

  • لإنشاء وإدارة حسابك، التحقق من هاتفك المحمول بواسطة OTP، وتوفير السوق، بما في ذلك مطابقة الطلبات مع الموردين وتمكين الكشف المدفوع (أداء العقد).
  • لحساب وتحصيل رسوم الكشف للعميل بنسبة 3% من القيمة المقدرة عند اختيارك للكشف عن المورد، وللحفاظ على السجلات المحاسبية (أداء العقد والالتزام القانوني). لا يدفع الموردون أي عمولة أو رسوم نجاح على المشاريع التي يفوزون بها.
  • للتحقق من الموردين والتحقق من مستندات KYC، منع الاحتيال وسوء الاستخدام، تأمين المنصة وتحسين خدماتنا (مصالح مشروعة).
  • لمشاركة تفاصيل الاتصال بالمورد المختار عند الكشف المدفوع، وللتسويق الاختياري (موافقتك، التي يمكنك سحبها في أي وقت).

حيث نعتمد على المصالح المشروعة، نوازن بينها وبين حقوقك ومصالحك.

4. الذكاء الاصطناعي والمعالجة الآلية

  • تنظم وتوحّد الطلبات التي تقدمها (بما في ذلك تحويل الصوت، الصور والرسومات إلى موجز منظم).
  • تطابق كل طلب مع الموردين المعتمدين الذين من المحتمل أن يكونوا قادرين على تقديم عرض.
  • تلخص الطلبات والعروض لجعلها أسهل للمقارنة.

تدعم هذه المعالجة الآلية خدمتنا ولكنها لا تنتج آثارًا قانونية ملزمة عليك دون تدخل بشري، وتظل حرًا في قبول أو رفض أو تجاهل أي عرض. يمكنك الاتصال بنا لطرح الأسئلة حول، أو الاعتراض على، المعالجة الآلية كما هو موضح في قسم حقوقك. حيث يمكن أن تؤثر المعالجة الآلية بشكل كبير على الأفراد، نقوم بتقييم تأثيرها قبل نشرها.

5. كيف نشارك البيانات

الخصوصية هي جوهر QuotesDone. نشارك البيانات الشخصية فقط كما يلي:

  • يتم مشاركة محتوى الطلب مع الموردين المطابقين دون الكشف عن هويتك، حتى يتمكن الموردون من إعداد عروض مجهولة الهوية.
  • يتم الكشف عن تفاصيل الاتصال الخاصة بك لمورد واحد فقط بعد دفعك لرسوم الكشف وموافقتك على الكشف لذلك المورد المختار؛ يتلقى الموردون بيانات اتصال العملاء فقط للمشاريع التي تم الكشف عنها لهم.
  • يتلقى معالج الدفع الخارجي لدينا البيانات اللازمة لإجراء الدفع (بطاقة أو Apple Pay) ويعيد مرجع الدفع.

قد نكشف أيضًا عن البيانات حيثما يقتضي القانون الإماراتي، أو محكمة ذات اختصاص، أو لحماية حقوقنا القانونية. نحن لا نبيع البيانات الشخصية.

  • يتم الاحتفاظ بمحتوى الطلب لتشغيل وتحسين المطابقة، ثم يتم حذفه أو جعله مجهولَ الهوية عندما لم يعد مطلوبًا.
  • يتم الاحتفاظ بالسجلات المالية والمعاملات، بما في ذلك سجلات رسوم الكشف واشتراكات الموردين، للفترات المطلوبة بموجب قانون المحاسبة والضرائب في الإمارات.

  • يتم الاحتفاظ بالسجلات لفترات محدودة لأغراض الأمان والتدقيق.

Refund & Cancellation Policy

Explains when the QuotesDone Reveal Fee is and is not refundable, how to request a refund, processing times and method, supplier registration-fee terms, and your preserved statutory rights under UAE Federal Law No. 15 of 2020.

1. About This Policy

This Refund & Cancellation Policy applies to QuotesDone, an online business-to-business quotation marketplace operated by QuotesDone Technologies (Dubai Sole Establishment; Dubai DET E-Trader (Professional) Licence No. 1633275; Commercial Register No. 2883503), Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

QuotesDone is a marketplace and facilitator only. We connect customers with suppliers and provide anonymised quotations. We are not a contractor, supplier or party to the works quoted, and this Policy governs only the fees you pay to QuotesDone, not amounts payable to a supplier under any separate contract you enter into.

This Policy must be read together with our Terms & Conditions. It is governed by the laws of the UAE and applied without prejudice to your non-waivable statutory rights under Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection and its Implementing Regulation (Cabinet Resolution No. 66 of 2023).

2. The Reveal Fee

To unlock the identity and contact details of a chosen supplier behind an anonymised quotation, you pay a Reveal Fee equal to 3% of the quoted amount. No cap applies to the Reveal Fee.

The Reveal Fee is a charge for the reveal service provided by QuotesDone. It is separate from, and additional to, any price agreed between you and the supplier for the actual goods, services or works.

Because the Reveal Fee unlocks supplier information immediately on payment, it is generally treated as earned once the reveal is delivered, subject to the specific refund right described below and to your statutory rights under UAE law.

3. When the Reveal Fee Is Refundable

We refund the Reveal Fee in one defined circumstance: where a revealed supplier does not respond to you within five (5) working days of your payment and does not respond to QuotesDone's CEO's final call. You do not need to prove anything for the clock to start: we track every reveal from the moment you pay. If the supplier has not responded within three (3) working days, we chase the supplier on your behalf and copy you; if there is still no response on the fifth (5th) working day, the case goes to QuotesDone's CEO for a final call; if the supplier does not respond to that call, the refund is issued.

If you have tried to reach the supplier yourself, dated copies of emails, messages sent through the Platform, or call logs help us close the case faster, but they are not a condition of the refund. Working days are Monday to Friday, excluding UAE public holidays.

If these conditions are met, the Reveal Fee for that supplier is refunded in full. The CEO's decision, whichever way it goes, is recorded against your refund case reference and the decision reference, and both are shown to you in your account and quoted when we confirm the outcome. This refund right is in addition to any remedy available to you under Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection.

4. When the Reveal Fee Is Not Refundable

The Reveal Fee is not refundable once the revealed supplier has responded to you within the five-working-day window, as the reveal service has then been fully delivered and the supplier has engaged.

The Reveal Fee is not refundable for a change of mind, for example where you decide not to proceed with a supplier who did respond, where you select a different supplier, or where the supplier's pricing or terms no longer suit you.

The Reveal Fee is not refundable where the supplier responded to you or to QuotesDone within the five-working-day window. Nothing in this section limits your non-waivable rights under UAE consumer protection law where they apply.

5. How to Request a Refund

You do not need to submit a request for a non-response refund: the ladder above runs automatically from the moment you pay. You can still tell us at any time that the supplier is not responding, by emailing management@quotesdone.com or by using the support function on the Platform, and we will chase the supplier immediately.

If you do write to us, your account email and the reveal reference are enough. Proof of your own attempts to reach the supplier (emails, Platform messages or call logs) is optional: it can help us close the case faster, but it is never a condition of the refund (see section 3).

We may ask for further information to identify your reveal. Providing complete and accurate information helps us assess and process eligible refunds promptly.

6. Processing Time and Method

Once QuotesDone's CEO decides a refund, it is issued to the original payment method through our payment processor, Stripe, and we confirm it to you with your refund case reference. Banks and card issuers usually take seven (7) to fourteen (14) working days to show the refund on your statement.

Payments handled by Stripe · PCI DSS. Your card or Apple Pay payment is processed by Stripe, a payment processor certified to the Payment Card Industry Data Security Standard; QuotesDone never sees or stores your full card number.

Refunds are made in the currency of the original payment and for the full Reveal Fee you paid. QuotesDone does not deduct an administrative charge from your refund. The administrative fee of AED 250 and the interest at 9% per annum that QuotesDone charges under the Supplier Agreement are charged to the supplier whose non-response caused the refund, never to you.

If a refund cannot be returned to the original payment method for reasons outside our control, we will agree an alternative lawful method with you.

7. Supplier Registration-Fee Terms

Suppliers may be charged a registration fee to join and maintain a profile on the Platform. QuotesDone charges suppliers no commission, success fee or transaction fee on jobs they win. These terms apply to suppliers, not to customers.

Any supplier registration fee is charged for access to the marketplace and listing services over the registration period. Where a fee covers a defined period, it is generally non-refundable for the unused portion once access has been granted, except where required by law or expressly agreed in writing.

8. Your Statutory Rights

Nothing in this Policy excludes, restricts or waives any right you may have under Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection and its Implementing Regulation (Cabinet Resolution No. 66 of 2023), or under other applicable UAE law.

Where a service is not provided as described, your statutory remedies under UAE consumer protection law continue to apply alongside the contractual refund right in this Policy.

If you believe your consumer rights have not been honoured, you may contact us first and, if unresolved, escalate to the relevant authority as set out in our Complaints & Dispute Resolution Policy.

نظرًا لأن رسوم الكشف تفتح معلومات المورد فور الدفع، فإنها تُعتبر مكتسبة عمومًا بمجرد تسليم الكشف، وذلك مع مراعاة حق الاسترداد المحدد الموضح أدناه وحقوقك القانونية بموجب قانون الإمارات.

إذا حاولت الوصول إلى المورد بنفسك، فإن النسخ المؤرخة من رسائل البريد الإلكتروني أو الرسائل المرسلة عبر المنصة أو سجلات المكالمات تساعدنا على إغلاق الحالة بشكل أسرع، لكنها ليست شرطًا للاسترداد. أيام العمل هي من الاثنين إلى الجمعة، باستثناء العطلات الرسمية في الإمارات.

لا تكون رسوم الكشف قابلة للاسترداد لتغيير الرأي، على سبيل المثال عندما تقرر عدم المضي قدمًا مع مورد استجاب، أو عندما تختار موردًا مختلفًا، أو عندما لم تعد أسعار أو شروط المورد تناسبك.

لا تكون رسوم الكشف قابلة للاسترداد عندما يستجيب المورد لك أو لـ QuotesDone في غضون نافذة الأيام الخمسة للعمل. لا يحد أي شيء في هذا القسم من حقوقك غير القابلة للتنازل بموجب قانون حماية المستهلك في الإمارات حيثما تنطبق.

يتم فرض أي رسوم تسجيل للمورد للوصول إلى السوق وخدمات الإدراج خلال فترة التسجيل. عندما تغطي الرسوم فترة محددة، فإنها تكون غير قابلة للاسترداد عمومًا للجزء غير المستخدم بمجرد منح الوصول، إلا إذا كان ذلك مطلوبًا بموجب القانون أو تم الاتفاق عليه صراحةً كتابيًا.

Supplier Agreement

For suppliers registering and quoting on QuotesDone.

1. Agreement & acceptance

This Supplier Agreement (the "Agreement") is a binding contract between QuotesDone Technologies, a Sole Establishment licensed by the Dubai Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) under E-Trader (Professional) Licence No. 1633275, Commercial Register No. 2883503, Dubai, United Arab Emirates, which operates the QuotesDone platform ("QuotesDone", "we", "us", "the Platform"), and the registering business ("you", "the Supplier"). Ticking the box constitutes a valid electronic signature under UAE Federal Decree-Law No. 46 of 2021 on Electronic Transactions and Trust Services. If you are accepting on behalf of a company, you warrant that you are authorised to bind that company.

2. Definitions

  • Customer — a user who requests quotations through the Platform.
  • Quotation Value — the total price the Supplier quotes for a job, exclusive of VAT.
  • Reveal — the point at which a Customer pays to unlock and select a Supplier for a job; a job is "won" upon Reveal.
  • Subscription Fee — the annual supplier subscription fee described in clause 6.
  • Working Days — days other than Saturdays, Sundays and UAE public holidays.

3. Eligibility & registration

To register you must be a lawfully established business in the UAE holding a valid trade licence covering the services you offer, and the individual registering must be authorised to act for that business. You agree to provide accurate, current and complete company, licence, tax (TRN), bank and contact information and to keep it updated.

4. Account & security

Access is secured by one-time-code verification. You are responsible for activity on your account and for keeping access credentials and the registered email secure. Notify us immediately of any unauthorised use.

5. The service

QuotesDone is an anonymous quotation marketplace and technology platform. Customers post jobs and receive anonymised quotations; the identities of Customer and Supplier are released only through the Platform after a Reveal. QuotesDone is an introducer and facilitator only; it is not the contractor, is not a party to the contract for the work, and does not supervise, perform or guarantee any work.

6. Registration & subscription fees

Supplier registration is free of charge for the first 1,000 businesses to register on the Platform, permanently. From the 1,001st registration a subscription fee of AED 1,000 per year applies, payable annually in advance. QuotesDone will give at least 30 days' notice and seek re-confirmation of acceptance before introducing or varying the fee, as set out in the Amendments section; continued use of the Platform after the effective date constitutes acceptance. The subscription fee, once paid, is non-refundable except as expressly stated at the time.

7. No supplier commission

QuotesDone charges the Supplier no commission on any job won through the Platform — not on the Quotation Value, not on the amount finally invoiced, and not on repeat work with the same Customer. The Platform is funded by the subscription fee in clause 6 and by a fee payable by the Customer at Reveal. QuotesDone reserves the right to introduce a supplier commission in future only on at least 30 days' notice and re-confirmation of acceptance as set out in the Amendments section; no commission is or becomes payable under this version of the Agreement.

8. Payment terms

Where a Subscription Fee is payable under clause 6, it is payable annually in advance, by card or by bank transfer, on the renewal date of the Supplier's account. QuotesDone may issue an invoice or statement for amounts due; payment is not conditional on receipt of an invoice. All amounts are in AED unless stated. Separately, the Customer — not the Supplier — pays QuotesDone a reveal fee of 3% of the Quotation Value at the moment of Reveal. Nothing is deducted from, or charged on, the amount the Customer pays the Supplier for the work.

9. Late payment

If a Subscription Fee is not received by its due date, QuotesDone may, after giving the Supplier notice and a further 7 Working Days to pay, suspend the Supplier's account until payment is made. Unpaid Subscription Fees are debts due and payable and may be recovered through the competent UAE courts. Overdue amounts carry interest at the single rate set out in clause 31. QuotesDone holds no funds for the Supplier (it collects only its own fees), so no set-off against held sums applies.

The Platform's value depends on anonymity. The Supplier must not, during anonymised stages or in on-platform chat, share or solicit phone numbers, email addresses, links, WhatsApp or other messaging or social-media handles, or otherwise attempt to take dealings off the Platform or bypass the Reveal. Any such disclosure or circumvention entitles QuotesDone to suspend the Supplier's account and to a liquidated sum of AED 10,000 per incident, agreed as a genuine pre-estimate of the lost platform value and lost subscription revenue, which is the sole monetary remedy for that incident (QuotesDone will not separately claim general damages for the same act). For a first and evidently inadvertent technical breach, QuotesDone may at its discretion issue a written warning instead of applying the sum. The Supplier acknowledges that this sum is agreed compensation (liquidated damages) under the UAE Civil Transactions Law, which a competent court may adjust to the actual loss.

11. Supplier obligations & conduct

The Supplier shall: honour every quotation it submits and any agreed timeline; respond to revealed Customers professionally and promptly; deal honestly and not engage in collusion, bid-rigging or price manipulation; and comply with all applicable UAE laws, including the Consumer Protection Law (Federal Law No. 15 of 2020) and health-and-safety requirements. QuotesDone, for its part, will operate the Platform in accordance with its own obligations as a digital marketplace under that law and its executive regulations.

Winning a job & response time. When a Customer reveals and selects the Supplier, the Supplier is notified that it has won the job and the Customer is given the Supplier's contact details (by SMS, WhatsApp and/or email) so the Customer can make contact. The Supplier must begin responding to the Customer within 5 working days of the Reveal. If the Supplier has not responded within 3 working days of the Reveal, QuotesDone chases the Supplier, copying the Customer; if there is still no response by the 5th working day the case goes to QuotesDone's CEO for a final call, and if the Supplier does not respond to that call the Customer's reveal fee is refunded and the non-response charge in clause 33 applies. The contract for the work itself is solely between the Supplier and the Customer, on terms they agree; QuotesDone is not a party to it and is not responsible for either party's performance, payment or conduct.

The Supplier must maintain a valid UAE trade licence and any approvals required for its trade, and upload renewals before expiry. The Supplier shall keep any Customer information received strictly confidential and use it only to fulfil the specific job. The Platform is provided on an "as is" and "as available" basis. QuotesDone does not warrant any volume of leads, quotations or jobs, uninterrupted availability, or that any Customer will proceed. To the extent permitted by law, all implied warranties are excluded.

18. Limitation of liability & indemnity

To the maximum extent permitted by UAE law, QuotesDone, its owners, staff and affiliates shall not be liable for disputes between the Supplier and a Customer, loss of business or profit, or any indirect or consequential loss; and QuotesDone's total aggregate liability to the Supplier shall not exceed the fees the Supplier paid to QuotesDone in the 12 months before the claim. The Supplier shall indemnify QuotesDone against claims, losses and costs arising from the Supplier's work, breach of this Agreement, or breach of law. Nothing excludes liability that cannot lawfully be excluded.

QuotesDone may suspend or terminate access for breach of this Agreement, non-payment, expired licensing, or conduct harmful to the Platform or its users. The Supplier may stop using the Platform at any time. Outstanding Subscription Fees and charges survive termination and remain payable.

Neither party is liable for failure or delay caused by events beyond its reasonable control.

Notices to the Supplier may be sent to the registered email or shown in the supplier portal; notices to QuotesDone should be sent to management@quotesdone.com.

For material changes — in particular any increase in fees — QuotesDone will give at least 30 days' notice and will ask the Supplier to re-confirm acceptance; a Supplier who does not accept a material change may terminate without penalty within the notice period. Non-material changes take effect when published on this page.

The Supplier acknowledges that any customer, project or lead made known to it through the Platform results directly from QuotesDone's introduction and is QuotesDone's protected commercial interest. Each breach entitles QuotesDone to liquidated compensation of AED 15,000 per incident, or three (3) times the fee that would otherwise have been payable, whichever is higher, in addition to recovery of the unpaid fee.

The Platform uses automated and AI-based tools to extract bills of quantities from drawings, standardise and anonymise quotations, generate cost estimates and comparisons, and power support and category assistants. The Supplier agrees that ticking the acceptance box, clicking to accept, or continuing to use the Platform constitutes a valid and binding electronic acceptance of this Agreement under the laws of the United Arab Emirates. Complaints & Dispute Resolution Policy

Sets out how to raise a complaint with QuotesDone, our acknowledgement and resolution timelines, the escalation path, our facilitation-only role in customer-supplier disputes, and your right to escalate to the relevant UAE authority and the courts of Dubai.

1. About This Policy

This Complaints & Dispute Resolution Policy applies to QuotesDone, operated by QuotesDone Technologies (Dubai Sole Establishment; Dubai DET E-Trader (Professional) Licence No. 1633275; Commercial Register No. 2883503), Dubai, United Arab Emirates.

We are committed to handling complaints fairly, promptly and in line with Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection and its Implementing Regulation (Cabinet Resolution No. 66 of 2023).

This Policy explains how to raise a complaint about the QuotesDone Platform or our services, how we respond, and your rights to escalate, including to the relevant UAE authority and the courts of Dubai.

2. How to Raise a Complaint

You can raise a complaint by emailing management@quotesdone.com or by sending a message marked as a complaint through our contact form. Every complaint receives a ticket number, and you can follow its status (acknowledged, in review, final response) at quotesdone.com/complaints/status using the ticket number and your email address.

To help us assist you quickly, please include your name and account details, the relevant quotation, reveal or supplier reference, a clear description of the issue, the outcome you are seeking, and any supporting evidence such as emails, Platform messages, screenshots or receipts.

We treat all complaints confidentially and handle personal data in accordance with Federal Decree-Law No. 45 of 2021 on the Protection of Personal Data and our Privacy Policy.

3. Acknowledgement and Resolution Timelines

We aim to acknowledge your complaint within two (2) working days of receipt and to provide a substantive response or resolution within ten (10) working days.

Where a complaint is complex or requires information from a third party, we will tell you and provide a revised timeframe, keeping you updated on progress.

Working days exclude Saturdays, Sundays and UAE public holidays. We maintain records of complaints and their outcomes to help us improve our service.

4. Our Role in Customer-Supplier Disputes

QuotesDone is a marketplace and facilitator only. We are not a contractor, supplier or party to any contract for goods, services or works formed between a customer and a supplier through the Platform.

Where a dispute concerns the supplier's quote, pricing, quality, licensing, conduct or completion of works, that is a matter between you and the supplier. Our role is limited to reasonable facilitation, such as sharing relevant Platform records or helping reconnect the parties.

Complaints that relate to the QuotesDone Platform itself, such as the Reveal Fee, the reveal service or account matters, are handled directly by us under this Policy.

5. Escalation Path

If you are not satisfied with our initial response, you may ask for your complaint to be reviewed by QuotesDone's CEO by replying to our response or emailing management@quotesdone.com and marking your message for escalation.

We will conduct a further review and aim to provide a final written response, setting out our position and the reasons for it, together with the external escalation routes in section 6.

If the matter remains unresolved after this internal escalation, you may pursue the external options described below.

6. Escalating to UAE Authorities

Because QuotesDone is licensed in Dubai, you may refer an unresolved consumer complaint to the Department of Economy and Tourism (DET) in Dubai through its Consumer Protection / Consumer Rights channels (including the Dubai Consumer App and website).

You may also contact the UAE Ministry of Economy consumer protection service, including its consumer hotline (800 1222), which receives and coordinates consumer complaints with the competent authorities.

These authorities handle complaints under Federal Law No. 15 of 2020 on Consumer Protection and its Implementing Regulation (Cabinet Resolution No. 66 of 2023). Referring a matter to them does not affect your other legal rights.

7. Governing Law and Courts

This Policy and any dispute arising from your use of QuotesDone are governed by the laws of the United Arab Emirates, including the Federal Decree-Law No. 50 of 2022 on Commercial Transactions and the Civil Transactions Law (Federal Decree-Law No. 25 of 2025) where applicable.

Subject to any mandatory consumer protection provisions and to the authority referral options above, the courts of Dubai have jurisdiction over disputes between you and QuotesDone.

Nothing in this Policy prevents you from exercising any non-waivable statutory right or from seeking the remedies available to you under applicable UAE law.
